components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Playfair Display Snippets logo in the header band.
components.css: .ds-logo { margin: 0; font-family: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif; font-size: 42px; font-weight: 400; color: #0b0b15; line-height: 1; }

components.name: About nav
components.description: Header About link; mute at rest, ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-about { font-family: "Spline Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; color: #535353; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-about:hover { color: #0d0d12; opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-about:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d0d12; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Site tagline
components.description: Uppercase tracked site line under the header rule.
components.css: .ds-tagline { margin: 0; font-family: "Sulphur Point", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #3e3e3e; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Featured section label
components.css: .ds-featured-label { margin: 0; font-family: "Zen Kaku Gothic Antique", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0b0b0c; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Featured title
components.description: Zen Antique lead title link; softens on hover.
components.html: The Real Cost of Context Switching
components.css: .ds-featured-title { margin: 0; max-width: 400px; font-family: "Zen Antique", Georgia, serif; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 400; color: #090912; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-featured-title a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; font: inherit; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-featured-title a:hover { opacity: 0.78; } .ds-featured-title a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d0d12; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Read more
components.description: Underlined text control with arrow; underline offset rises on hover.
components.css: .ds-readmore { color: #0d0d0d; font-family: "Noto Sans Kannada", Actor, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-readmore span { display: inline-block; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; transition: text-underline-offset 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-readmore:hover span { text-underline-offset: 7px; } .ds-readmore:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d0d12; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Rail item
components.description: Latest-posts row: title plus mute middot meta and soft hairline.
components.html: Small Systems, Big ResultsMay 5, 2024 • 5 min read
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; color: #0d0d12; text-decoration: none; padding-right: 12px; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-rail-item:hover { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d0d12; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rail-title { font-family: "Port Lligat Slab", Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-rail-meta { margin-top: 12px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #c4c4c4; font-family: Actor, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: #686868; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-rail-item:hover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Hairline rules
components.description: Header and column 1px rules that structure the C3 split.
components.css: .ds-rules { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 120px; background: #f8f8f8; } .ds-rule-header { height: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #909090; } .ds-rule-col { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 24px; bottom: 0; width: 1px; background: #545454; }

narrative.overview:
Snippets reads as a quiet personal broadsheet: one wide featured essay leads, a tempered latest rail keeps the next few posts in reach. The page is paper and ink, not a marketing surface. Hairline rules structure the split; serif titles carry the voice; sans meta stays secondary. Middot metadata is the only post taxonomy on the index.

Density is editorial and measured to a fixed 1280×720 craft frame that scales on desktop, then stacks into a single column under 900px. Motion is restrained: one authored fade on enter, then small link-state cues. No cards, chips, accent fills, or promo modules.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground (#f8f8f8) and near-black ink (#0d0d12) only; no brand accent color
C3 wide-featured split (~50/50 column rule, featured left / latest rail right) on a 10% region grid
Serif titles + sans body/meta; uppercase tracked section labels
Middot metadata (date • duration); no colored tag chips
Flat paper with hairline rules; no shadows or elevation chrome
Single home-fade entrance; scale shell on desktop, stacked flow on mobile

rules.name: The Paper-Only Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay paper and ink. Do not introduce a brand accent, tinted panels, or colored chips on the index.

rules.name: The Middot Meta Rule
rules.body: Post metadata is plain ink/mute type joined by • only. No tag pills, category colors, or badge fills.

rules.name: The Role-Face Rule
rules.body: Keep each region's loaded face. Do not collapse the index to a single display/body pair unless the approved comp changes.

rules.name: The Label Case Rule
rules.body: Section markers (tagline, featured label, rail label) stay uppercase with tracked spacing; titles and body stay sentence case.

rules.name: The C3 Split Rule
rules.body: Desktop home keeps the wide featured + latest rail composition from .impeccable/mocks/approved/home-split-c3.png. Do not replace it with a hero stack, card grid, or centered marketing column.

rules.name: The Scale-Then-Stack Rule
rules.body: Above 900px, preserve the craft frame via scale. At 900px and below, stack; do not keep a cramped absolute split.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows, cards, or lifted surfaces to the index. Rules and type weight do the structuring.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Dividers are 1px solid greys from the rule ladder. Do not thicken into bars or replace with filled blocks.

dos: Do keep Paper / Ink as the only ground and primary text pair.
Do use middot metadata (date • duration) for posts.
Do preserve the C3 featured + rail split and the 10% region grammar on desktop.
Do scale the 1280×720 frame above 900px; stack below.
Do keep motion to home-fade plus small link cues; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add colored tag chips, accent fills, or marketing hero modules.
Don't introduce cards, shadows, or rounded chrome on the index.
Don't invent button, chip, or input styles that are not in the build.
Don't replace role-specific faces with a collapsed generic pairing without a new approved comp.
